title: CES walkthrough configuration (config.local.json)
description: Every URL, root and token the walkthrough reads. config.local.json is gitignored; the two examples are committed. The server refuses to start when a required field is missing. Shape A (mode "ports") also requires roots; shape B (mode "remote") requires testerRoot instead and never reads a module folder.

mode.description: Which run shape (PLAN.md 11.2). "ports": the page runs on the machine that runs the modules, on their kit ports, and shares their folders. "remote": the page runs on any machine and reaches the modules only over HTTP(S) at the addresses in urls (path prefixes allowed). Absent: ports when every URL is loopback and roots are set, remote otherwise.

name.description: Shown in the page header, for example "contractor host" or "kit ports".

testerRoot.description: Built ces-tester folder (dist present) on the machine running the page. The engine and Playwright load from here. Shape A may give it as roots.testerRoot instead.

caFile.description: PEM file with the certificate the module host presents (a self-signed one is fine). Relative paths resolve against this config file's folder. Used for the walkthrough's own HTTPS calls and its module forwarders.

ignoreErrors.description: Fallback when no caFile: skip certificate checks for the module host (shown as a yellow health item).

scenario.description: Simulator scenario the simulator must be serving, for example s1-mach.

tenantSlug.description: Tenant slug shared by the record, AO, EO and Stamper.

testerRoot.description: Built ces-tester folder (dist present). The engine is loaded from here.

tenantRoot.description: The CES_TENANT_ROOT your AO, EO, Stamper and muster-api use.

pipelineRoot.description: The CES_PIPELINE_ROOT your modules use (ces.db, Stamper plan-data).

roots.description: Shape A only: the module folders the walkthrough links (junctions). Leave out in shape B.

CES_EO_URL.description: What your muster-api was started with (the push reaches EO through it).

EC_URL.description: What your EO was started with.

STACKSIM_SERVER_URL.description: What AO, EO and Stamper were started with. AO needs a loopback value.

ao.description: CES_AO_AUTH_TOKEN, used by the health probe only. Leave empty for a token-less AO.

eo.description: CES_EO_AUTH_TOKEN. Typed into EvidenceOps' access screen. Shape B: also sent as the bearer on every EvidenceOps call; the Setup panel asks for it.

eoOperator.description: A BHD operator token for EO's access screen (mints uploader and approver tokens).

stamper.description: CES_STAMPER_AUTH_TOKEN. Shape A: health probe only (leave empty for a token-less Stamper). Shape B: sent as the bearer on every Stamper call; the Setup panel asks for it.

musterOperator.description: An operator account on your muster-api (scripts/seed.ts creates one).

uploaderUpn.description: Fictional uploader from the scenario's document-reviews.json.

controlId.description: A control with no stack source, for example PE.L2-3.10.2.

objectiveId.description: One of its objectives, for example PE.L2-3.10.2[b].

aoNewUser.description: The fictional joiner that step 13 (AdminOps A-01) creates in the simulated tenant.

headed.description: true opens visible browser windows as well as the in-page mirror.

slowMoMs.description: Playwright slow motion per action, so a person can follow. Default 250.

windows.description: Where each module window opens: { muster | stamper | ao | eo: { x, y, width, height } } in screen pixels. scripts\mine.mjs measures the screen and writes it when absent (PLAN.md 13.2 item 3).

managedByWalkthrough.description: Kit localhost only: true lets Prepare seed and serve the simulator when port 4390 is free.
